name: causal-impact-campaign
description: Measure the causal impact of marketing campaigns, promos, or interventions on business metrics using Bayesian structural time series. Full pipeline: data exploration, covariate engineering, 9-method analysis, Specification Curve Analysis (440-spec robustness sweep), permutation validation, placebo calibration, methodology communication guide (verified tfcausalimpact p-value formula, identification assumptions, 'three tests, three different questions' framing, 'diagnose, don't demote' protocol with worked example and placebo-rank implementation gotchas), and client-facing deliverables. Includes merged permutation-validation and bsts-placebo-calibration skills.
